description: This source file defines the 'ThingPersistenceActor' class, which is an Akka actor responsible for maintaining and managing the persistent state of a single 'Thing' object within the system. It handles persistence configuration, recovery, event publishing, and interaction strategies for 'Thing' entities.

classes.name: ThingPersistenceActor
classes.description: An Akka persistent actor managing the lifecycle, state, and events of a single 'Thing' entity, including persistence, recovery, and event publication.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Creates configuration 'Props' for instantiating a 'ThingPersistenceActor' with specified parameters.

methods.name: persistenceId
methods.description: Returns the unique persistence ID for the actor, used for event sourcing.

methods.name: journalPluginId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the journal plugin used for event persistence.

methods.name: snapshotPluginId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the snapshot plugin used for state snapshotting.

methods.name: getEventClass
methods.description: Provides the class type of the events managed by this actor.

methods.name: getStrategyContext
methods.description: Provides the context for command strategies, including logging and entity identification.

methods.name: getCreatedStrategy
methods.description: Retrieves the command strategy for creating 'Thing' entities.

methods.name: getDeletedStrategy
methods.description: Retrieves the command strategy for deleting 'Thing' entities.

methods.name: getEventStrategy
methods.description: Provides the strategy for handling incoming 'Thing' events.

methods.name: getActivityCheckConfig
methods.description: Retrieves the configuration used to check activity status of the entity.

methods.name: getSnapshotConfig
methods.description: Retrieves the snapshot configuration for this actor.

methods.name: entityExistsAsDeleted
methods.description: Checks if the current entity exists marked as deleted.

methods.name: newNotAccessibleExceptionBuilder
methods.description: Constructs a builder for exceptions when the 'Thing' entity is not accessible.

methods.name: recoveryCompleted
methods.description: Handles logic when recovery of persisted events has completed, updating the entity state accordingly.

methods.name: publishEvent
methods.description: Publishes a 'ThingEvent' to the distributed pub-sub system.

methods.name: getEntitySchemaVersion
methods.description: Returns the schema version implemented by the 'Thing' entity.
